as_told.title: Jake Barber senses a conscious craft during recovery

plain: Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot, says that sometime after about 2014 he flew a mission in the California desert to pick up a flying disc he calls the eight-gon, because from above it looked split into eight sections. He says that while flying it back, hanging below his helicopter, he felt overwhelmed, and podcast host Jesse Michels adds that Barber described locking on to it with his mind and feeling a gentle, divine feminine presence that made him emotional. If true, it would mean the US recovers craft that may respond to human consciousness.
